Method of Attack: Abuses Better Stack (formerly Logtail) to exfiltrate MongoDB connection info, cryptocurrency wallet addresses, balances, and private keys
Targets wallets with crypto balance greater than 1000
Gains persistence via pm2 cron jobs for continuous data collection
result.Impacted Systems: Node.js/Bun applications, Systems with MongoDB and cryptocurrency wallets
Attack Vector: Use of Better Stack's @logtail/node package to send stolen data to threat actor endpoint
Indicators of Compromise: start.js file containing Better Stack exfiltration code
